hypothesis: Version 1 showed the official SDPA configuration runs out of memory on a T4 in its first forward pass at 8,192 tokens per GPU. The official recipe fits a T4 pair unchanged in its arithmetic if the LLM's activations are recomputed in the backward pass (gradient checkpointing) and DDP's gradient buckets share the gradients' storage - and, failing that, with AdamW applying the same update one tensor at a time. The test: the SDPA configuration with those techniques runs 8 optimizer steps on both GPUs; and on one GPU at a test-only 512-token batch, the first loss and the gradients before the first update match the official path's.
changes_from_v1: out-of-memory is read from the per-process records and the whole log, not the log's last 25 lines (the v1 bug that skipped the fallback)
flex_attention is not repeated (v1: out of memory in the first step; the official docs send GPUs older than Ampere to SDPA)

memory techniques: gradient checkpointing (non-reentrant) on the LLM, DDP gradient_as_bucket_view, and if needed AdamW with foreach=False; PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True goes with them, never with the official attempt

the equivalence check runs on one GPU at 512 tokens and compares the first loss and a fingerprint of the first step's gradients (their norm after clipping and the sums of six tensors), taken before the update

budget_declared_before_the_push.expected_minutes: about 20-25: install 6, downloads 1, data 1, tokenising 6, the official SDPA control 1, each memory attempt about 3-5, the equivalence runs 2-3
budget_declared_before_the_push.hard_limits: the same per-command timeouts as v1

reading.a memory mode runs 8 steps and the equiv: the recipe runs on a T4 pair with memory-only changes; its measured seconds per step, times 5,000, plus tokenising and evaluation, is the full run's cost, compared with the free quota before anything long is sent
reading.a memory mode runs but the equivalence f: the techniques changed something; no long run on them
reading.nothing fits: the full recipe needs a GPU with more memory; the report gives the evidence and the command, with nothing reduced
